title: Hades + Sekiro + Cyberpunk = PARRYGOD (I need help)
author: im_out_of_creativity
selftext:
Hey everyone! A few days ago, I had the idea of combining elements from some of my favorite games, and that’s how I came up with Parrygod. It’s a Hades-style roguelike with a parry mechanic like Sekiro’s, set in a Japanese cyberpunk world.

I started working on it about three days ago. My current workflow is to use Unity as the engine, generate characters and environments with Magnific, turn them into 3D models with Tripo, and animate them with Mixamo.

I also installed Unimate to try generating animations with AI, but I’m really struggling with rigging and getting good animations that actually fit the game. The character models themselves aren’t looking that great yet either.

Does anyone have any tips for improving the models, rigging, and animations? Or suggestions for a different workflow that could help me get better results?

My background is in design, and I don’t have any coding experience, so any help would be appreciated!

I'm using Opus 5.5 on max effort.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Okay. 

Please, please: 

  
Conceptualize the game first. 'A Hades style roguelike with the parry mechanic from Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice' is not really a concept, it's just a mechanic and an aesthetic. What is the player going to do aside from parry? 

  
And... Parrygod? For real? 

Surely we can do slightly better than that?

comments.author: jonydevidson
comments.body:
I recommend generating AI videos of moves and then using Video to Animation. In the prompt write that it's supposed to be a 3-view look of the animation like from 3 sides: side, top, front. If the quality is inconsistent across the 3 shots then go back to single shot.

There are services that can already give you an animation from a single video, you just have to do a bit of cleanup then. 

You can also try using some open source stuff or have the AI agent pull out keyframes from the video and have it do the animating frame by frame.

Check out Cascadeur for cleanup and manual animations.

comments.author: hobobum
comments.body: The name is among the worst I’ve seen not because it’s cringy and bad, but because it immediately eviscerates your potential market size: parry is a mechanic many despise and will not play games which require it. You now need to reach people who want parry, like roguelites, and challenging combat. Do yourself a favor and change that name.
